ihr.et: From Middle High German ir, from Old High German ir, from Proto-West Germanic *jiʀ, from Proto-Germanic *jīz. Cognate with Low German ji, jie, Yiddish איר (ir), Dutch jij, gij, je, Middle Dutch ir, English ye, Gothic 𐌾𐌿𐍃 (jūs).

Laura showed me her new car.

The cat often plays with her toys.

ihr.et: From Old High German ira, from Proto-Germanic *hezōi.
